title: D-label with bounded index
statement: For natural numbers $C,d$ and an index $i$, define a $D$-label indexed by $i$ when $i\le d$, and by $0$ otherwise; the label is drawn from the family whose $D$-indices range over $\text{Fin}(d+1)$.
